question: Intama zororoka gute?
answer: Intama zororoka mu buryo bukurikira: Ku ntama 100 zimye, habyara 85; Ku ntama zibyara, havuka abana 140 ku nyarwanda, 180 ku za kijyambere. Intama ihaka iminsi 149-152, (amezi 5). Yonsa amezi atatu, ishobora rero kubyara buri mezi 9 iyo yorowe kijyambere.
spoken_text: Intama zororoka mu buryo bukurikira: Ku ntama ijana zimye, habyara mirongo inani na gatanu; Ku ntama zibyara, havuka abana ijana na mirongo ine ku nyarwanda, ijana na mirongo inani ku za kijyambere. Intama ihaka iminsi ijana na mirongo ine n'icyenda kugeza kuri ijana na mirongo itanu na kabiri, (amezi gatanu). Yonsa amezi atatu, ishobora rero kubyara buri mezi icyenda iyo yorowe kijyambere.

question: Umusaruro w'inkwavu uba uhagaze gute?
answer: Urukwavu rutanga inyama zingana na 60 % z'ibiro byarwo ari ruzima.

question: Umuhinzi abona ubwishingizi bw'ibihingwa ate?
answer: Umuhinzi ukeneye ubwishingizi bw'ibihingwa, agana ibigo bitanga ubwishingizi bifitanye amasezerano na MINAGRI cyangwa akegera agoronome w'umurenge ahingamo akamufasha. Nyuma yo kumvikana hagati y'umuhinzi n'ikigo cy'ubwishingizi kuburyo bw'imikoranire umuhinzi yishyura 60 % y'ikiguzi cy'ubwishingizi, agahabwa amasezerano agaragaza ko yafashe ubwishingizi, 40 % yishyurwa na Leta.
